title: Rudder Trailing Edge Panel — Fastener Hole Restoration
abstract: Restoration of an oversize or damaged fastener hole in a rudder trailing edge panel, up to the limit at which the repair manual takes over, with the mass control the balanced surface requires.

sections.purpose: This task restores a fastener hole in a rudder trailing edge panel that is oversize, elongated or damaged, within the limits given here. Beyond those limits the repair manual scheme applies.
sections.job_setup_note: The rudder is a balanced surface. Every gram added or removed must be recorded, and the mass balance check must be done before the surface is refitted. Work with the rudder off the aircraft and on a trestle; a hole cannot be drilled true with the surface hanging on its hinges.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the rudder on the trestle set and support it at all three hinge positions. WARNING: THE RUDDER IS A BALANCED SURFACE. DO NOT ADD OR REMOVE MASS EXCEPT AS THIS TASK ALLOWS, AND RECORD EVERYTHING YOU DO. 2. Identify the damaged hole and measure it in two planes ninety degrees apart. 3. Compare the larger measurement against the limits table. Where it exceeds the table, stop and use the repair manual scheme. 4. Clean the area and remove the protective scheme locally by abrasion. Do not use a chemical stripper on the laminate. 5. Ream the hole to the next oversize using the guide bush in the drill jig. Take light cuts and clear the swarf between cuts. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE REAMER RUN DRY. THE LAMINATE WILL DELAMINATE AT THE EXIT SIDE. 6. Examine the hole bore with a magnifier for delamination and fibre break-out. 7. Where the plate D5540112864257 is involved, check that the reamed hole still meets the edge distance for the machined lug boss. 8. Install the oversize fastener with the countersunk washer AGS613028-9C under the head. 9. Where a splice plate D5540117054490 fastener is restored, torque it to the value in the limits table and lock it. 10. Restore the protective scheme to the standard practice for a bonded joint. 11. Record the mass of material removed and of fastener added. 12. Do the mass balance check before the rudder is refitted.
sections.close_out: Record every restored hole position on the panel map, with the oversize used. Record the net mass change and the mass balance result. Where more than four holes in one panel have been restored, refer the panel to engineering before it is refitted.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the edge distance check of step 7 applies only post modification

safety_precautions: Support the rudder at all three hinge positions.
Wear eye protection when reaming laminate.
